# Deutsche Welle (DW)

> > Deutsche Welle provides international news coverage with focus on global politics, conflicts, and democratic developments, particularly involving the USA, Iran, Israel, Germany, and emerging geopolitical tensions.

DW is Germany's international broadcaster offering multilingual news and analysis on world affairs. Coverage emphasizes European perspectives on Middle East conflicts, US politics under Donald Trump, German domestic politics including Friedrich Merz and the AfD, and human rights issues globally.

## Key Topics

- USA and Donald Trump
- Iran and Middle East conflict
- Israel and Nahost-Konflikt
- Friedrich Merz and German politics
- AfD and German democracy
- Supreme Court and US trade policy
- Terrorismus and security
- Wahlkampf and elections
- Trump tariffs and economic policy
- Gisèle Pelicot and gender-based violence
- CDU and German coalition politics
- Russia (Russland) and geopolitics
- Turkey (Türkei) and regional politics
- Presidential authority and constitutional law
- Feministische movements and social justice

- [Eskalation in Nahost](https://www.dw.com/de/eskalation-in-nahost/g-76166601): Israel and USA strike Iran targets, Iran retaliates with counterattacks

- [China schmiedet Anti-USA-Allianz nach Angriffen auf Iran](https://www.dw.com/de/china-schmiedet-anti-usa-allianz-nach-angriffen-auf-den-iran/a-76177750): China criticizes US-Israel Iran strikes, forges anti-USA alliance for oil
